plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Economics AA-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 23, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8048/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 59-62; lower bound 59 encoded = 15+15+13+16 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 1 statistics choice ECON 310/STAT C1000E/PSYC 330 -> 3; Sem 2 ACCT 301/ACCT 311/CISC 310 -> 3; Sem 4 MATH 400/MATH 341 -> 4). LINKED ECON PRINCIPLES: Semester 1 offers ECON C2002 Principles of Macroeconomics or ECON C2001 Principles of Microeconomics (3 units); Semester 2 offers the one not taken in Semester 1 (map footnote). Both require Elementary Algebra or eligibility for higher level math (placement; documented here, not encoded). STATISTICS CHOICE: ECON 310 Statistics for Business and Economics (3 units; suggested for ECON majors), STAT C1000E Introduction to Statistics (4 units), or PSYC 330 Introductory Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences (3 units); all require Elementary Algebra or eligibility for higher level math (placement; documented here, not encoded). Lower bound 3 encoded. SEMESTER 2 CHOICE: ACCT 301 Financial Accounting (4 units; advisory ACCT 101, BUS 105, MATH 120 or MATH 125; suggested course), ACCT 311 Managerial Accounting (4 units; requires ACCT 301 per map — note ACCT 301 is the alternative option in this same choice slot, not a separately sequenced course), or CISC 310 Introduction to Computer Information Science (3 units; advisory familiar with basic word processing/spreadsheet/browser functions). Lower bound 3 encoded. Option-specific prerequisites/advisories documented here, not encoded on the choice slots. SEMESTER 3 CHOICE: ECON 306 Environmental Economics (3 units; advisory MATH 120 or 125 or 1 yr HS Algebra II; suggested course) or AGB 321 Agriculture Economics (3 units). CALCULUS CHOICE: MATH 400 Calculus I (5 units; requires MATH 370 or MATH 372 AND Math 373) or MATH 341 Calculus for Business and Economics (4 units; requires Intermediate Algebra or eligibility for higher level math). Lower bound 4 encoded. Semester 2 Area 4 footnote: select a course not in ECON; a total of 6 units from 2 disciplines is required for CalGETC Area 4. Semester 3 'IGETC Area 5A' row carries GE AREA Cal-GETC 5A (typo; encoded 5A). Transferable electives: units needed to total 60 for graduation. The AA-T may be obtained by completing 60 transferable semester units with a minimum 2.0 GPA.
